text:
Hi there, and thanks for contacting Leafy! 🌿 Great question.

Unfortunately, you can't stack the two on the same item. A promo code can't be combined with Leafy Plus member pricing on the same pot (or any item).

The good news is you don't have to choose or do any math yourself:
- **The better discount applies automatically** at checkout, so you'll always get the bigger saving on that item.

A few related things that might help:
- Only **one promo code** can be used per order.
- Promo codes **can't be added after an order is placed**, so it's best to check your total at checkout before you confirm.
- Your 10% Plus member pricing on pots and accessories is separate from the promo code, so if the code doesn't apply to an item, you'll still get your member price there.

If you'd like, tell me the details of your promo code and I can help you think through which one is likely to come out ahead, though I'd only be able to go by what's in our policies.

Thanks for being a Leafy Plus member, and happy potting! Reach out any time. 🪴
